title: CION Investment Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: CION Investment Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 6, 2026, announcing that it will report Q1 2026 financial results on May 7, 2026 before market open and host an earnings call at 11 a.m. ET that same day. The filing also confirms the company's securities listings on NYSE (CION common stock, CICB 7.50% notes due 2029, CICC 7.50% notes due 2031).
key_points: CION Investment Corporation is a Maryland-incorporated business development company (BDC) with SEC file number 814-00941
The company will release Q1 2026 earnings on May 7, 2026 prior to market open
An earnings conference call is scheduled for 11 a.m. Eastern Time on May 7, 2026
CION common stock (CION) and two note issuances (CICB due 2029, CICC due 2031) trade on NYSE
The filing was signed by Co-CEO Michael A. Reisner on April 6, 2026
This is a routine regulatory disclosure under Items 2.02, 7.01, and 9.01 of Form 8-K
